caption: A coil of rope is thrown onto a dock, and it lands in a loose tangle of loops.

sa.check: A coil of rope is thrown onto a dock.
It lies in a loose tangle of loops.
The throw comes first and the landing follows.

pc.expect: The loops lie on top of one another and the rope does not pass through itself.
pc.fail: It passes through itself; or through the dock; or the loops run into one another.

pc.expect: It bends into loops and keeps its length.
pc.fail: It lands in a straight line; or stretches; or splits.

pc.expect: It falls and lies on the dock.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or hangs.
It is rigid; or bounces high; or melts.

pc.expect: One rope keeps its number and its two ends.
pc.fail: It duplicates; or vanishes; or the ends multiply.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rope's colour and the dock stay the same.
pc.fail: The rope changes colour; or the dock changes; or the water rearranges.
